title: Sbitennik Drink Order
description: Sbitennik Drink Order — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Khodebshchik

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to the lower side areas off Levels 5 and 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Kill Cinder Hulks, Volcanic Gushers, and Lava Pincers, and collect 10 Volcanic Berries and 40 Fiery Talons. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Khodebshchik

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Sbitennik Drink Delivery

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to the lower side areas off Levels 5 and 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Kill Cinder Hulks, Volcanic Gushers, and Lava Pincers, and collect 10 Volcanic Berries and 40 Fiery Talons. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Offer:

I have all that I need to produce some mythic-quality Sbitennik, except I'm missing two things. 'Fiery Talons' and 'Cave Oysters.'

I had trouble with some translations, so I asked the locals. The man I talked to was explaining to me what a 'Fiery Talon' was, when he drifted into some horribly bizarre story involving himself and a red-haired woman. He told this woman that she had the face of a dog's rear end. She then reared her ugly head and dug her claws into him with a fiery vengeance. I'll spare you the rest of the bizarre story, but eventually I did learn that Lava Pincers have 'Fiery Talons'.

A very excited lad was extremely helpful in deciphering the 'Cave Oysters' ingredient. Normally, I wouldn't ask a child for help, but every time I asked about 'Cave Oysters' from adults it always produced an awkward look followed by an ample amount of laughter. 'Cave oysters' are symbiotic like tumors that come from Cinder Hulks and Volcanic Gushers. I only want the largest and juiciest bits that you can find. You just snip those tumors clean off, bag them, and deliver them to Khodebshchik okay? OH, and never, ever, ever, tell anyone that I'm making any sort of concoction with 'Cave Oysters.' I'm calling them 'Volcanic Berries.' It sounds mysterious, tasty, and yet ever-so-inviting.

Snip, snip! Chop, chop! Run along now and collect forty Fiery Talons from Lava Pincers and ten Volcanic Berries from Cinder Hulks or Volcanic Gushers. I'll be here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell doing some more research.

Turn-in:

Thank you for the help. I cannot begin to tell you how reliable you are. I keep sending other helpers to fetch me some 'Cave Oysters,' but they never come back. I have learned never to trust anyone in a red shirt to venture off into a dark cave and to return.

Let me just whip up a quick batch of this and then I will need for you to deliver it for me.

Objectives:

  • Fiery Talons ×40
  • Volcanic Berries ×10

Client level range: 75–100
